run_GetCommandOutput: run a shell command and capture its stdout output as a list of stripped lines
run_GetSvnInfo: run svn info to get the project name and current SVN workspace root path
run_GetSvnTrunk: run svn info to retrieve the current SVN workspace trunk root path
run_IsInGTestSvn: run a check to determine if the current directory is inside the googletest SVN repository
run_IsInGMockSvn: run a check to determine if the current directory is inside the googlemock SVN repository
